messages.content: Translate the question into Italian if it is in English, into English if it is in Italian. Keep names, numbers and dates. Return only the translation.
By which date must the Commission submit its first report on the evaluation and review of Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 (Article 53(1))?

response.text: Entro quale data la Commissione deve presentare la prima relazione sulla valutazione e sul riesame del regolamento (UE) 2023/1230 (articolo 53, paragrafo 1)?
